title: The Chair Saved at the Assembly
youtube_title: The Chair Saved at the Assembly | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A thank-you that takes effort feels true.
summary: At a library corner with a paper ribbon in a book, Lior notices that Mr. Ade has already taken care of a chair saved without a fuss. A quick thank-you feels too thin, so Lior does one useful thing Mr. Ade did not ask for and then says, plainly, that they noticed.
